subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence,

She said that she **will go **to market later.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"will"** is used to indicate a future action or decision. (भविष्य में होने वाली क्रिया या निर्णय का संकेत देना)

 
 
• **Example:** She will attend the meeting tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **"Would"** is the past tense of "will," and it is often used to express a future action from the perspective of a past event. (भूतकाल में भविष्य की क्रिया का संकेत देना)
 
 
• **Example:** She said she would join us for dinner.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the future action "will go" is reported in indirect speech, so it needs to be changed to "would go" to align with the past-tense "said."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1 - Shall go** (जाना चाहिए): Used to express determination or obligation, but less common in modern usage.

 
 
• **Example:** We shall overcome all obstacles.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 - Could go** (जा सकता था): Indicates possibility or ability in the past or future.
 
 
• **Example:** She could go to the market if she had time.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - Can go** (जा सकता है): Refers to ability or permission in the present or future.
 
 
• **Example:** You can go to the park after finishing your homework.
 
 

15f:Tca9,

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Patrimony**.
